item.description: ### Fixed - **Claude: a session without Perch's hooks keeps its own row.** If another Claude run finished in the same folder, such as `claude -p`, the live session's row could switch to that finished run. A session waiting on you then stopped showing as needing you. Two such sessions in one folder could also show as one. Perch now goes by Claude's own record of which session each process runs, when the session's transcript confirms it. This also covers a `--resume` session after `/clear`.
